    DYSTOPIAN      STATE

    Our Story

    FOR PEOPLE FROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE

    When we opened the brewery in Tacoma called Dystopian State Brewing Company, we wanted to create a place for families and friends in our community to gather and share the joy of great beer. 

     

    As craft beer lovers ourselves, we’re committed to brewing unique and interesting beers and serving them in a cozy, welcoming taproom. We believe the best beer is made with simple, natural ingredients. The result is 18 different taps of bold, incredible flavor from the first sip to the last drop. 

     

    Every special occasion needs a toast, and our event space is the perfect spot to raise your glass while overlooking the Commencement Bay. 

    ​

    We cherish the diversity of gender, age, race, ethnicity, national origin, range of abilities, sexual orientation, gender identity, financial means, education and political perspective.

    ​

    There’s something for everyone here, and we can’t wait to share our passion for great beer with you. Our mission has always been to share well-crafted beer with everyone in our community. 

     

    Event Venue

    FOR THE MEMORABLE MOMENTS IN LIFE

    Dystopian State Brewing Company located in Tacoma, WA, is a brewery and event venue that offers gathering spaces for up to 250 guests. Ideal for rehearsal dinners, graduations, corporate events, celebrations of life, birthdays, engagement parties, and wedding showers, this industrial-chic establishment is the perfect spot for a memorable experience.

    ​

    ​Couples and guests are invited to visit Dystopian State Brewing Co's modern and welcoming tap room to relax and enjoy a house-brewed beer. With its warm lighting, exposed beams, and open-plan floor space, it exudes a contemporary style that can be personalized to suit your needs and requirements. During your event, a partial or the entire taproom can be rented, ensuring a private and exclusive experience of this charming establishment.

    The Beers

    LOCALLY CRAFTED & AGED TO PERFECTION

    We at Dystopian State Brewing Co, work tirelessly to bring you the best beer you can find in Tacoma, WA.  Only natural ingredients are used and the types of beer vary widely so that you can have a rotating variety of original, true to style, meticulously hand crafted ales.

    You work hard to enjoy your beer.  The beer you drink should work just as hard for you.
